tool.name: generate-sqlmi-maintenance-report
tool.description: Read-only Azure SQL Managed Instance maintenance resilience report: maintenance windows, connection type, failover groups, real reconfigurations (Resource Health, Activity Log), upcoming planned maintenance (Service Health), per-application user impact from Application Insights and recommended window from real load. HTML + JSON + 2 CSV. Never changes anything.

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: report (HTML+JSON+2 CSV, default), summary (KPIs, findings, apps) or upcoming (next planned maintenance and at-risk apps).

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: History window: last_30d (default), last_14d or last_7d.

parameters.name: data_source
parameters.description: auto (default: live if configured, otherwise demo), live or demo (simulated data).

skill.name: sqlmi-maintenance-resilience
skill.description: Azure SQL Managed Instance resilience to maintenance windows: windows, reconfigurations, upcoming maintenance, per-application user impact and recommended window. Read-only.

agent.name: sqlmi-maintenance-advisor
agent.handoffDescription: Read-only advisor for Azure SQL Managed Instance maintenance windows, reconfiguration impact on applications and retry readiness.

schedule.name: SQL MI - Weekly maintenance resilience report
schedule.description: Every Monday: last week's SQL MI reconfigurations, user impact, applications without retries and upcoming maintenance (read-only).
schedule.agentPrompt: @sqlmi-maintenance-advisor Generate the weekly SQL Managed Instance maintenance resilience report (operation=report, period=last_7d). Deliver the 4 download links (HTML, JSON, instances CSV and impact CSV), the short answer, the next maintenance with the applications at risk and the High priority actions.
